render_attempts.prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large senior keeper and apprentice at the center, jointly comparing preserved knowledge while witnesses gather around them. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: scribes compare two damaged records in a side alcove; a family teaches a child from a preserved manuscript; couriers exchange custody beneath a bridge; restorers repair a fragile archive chamber. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

Its dedicated exact-head and exact-merge workflow gates pass.
The reference schedule bounds intentional timing by a 24 ms candidate window with a 32 ms hard cap and does not sum delay serially per active face.
Late proposal classifications preserve provenance rather than silently deleting a face.
24 ms is universally imperceptible to humans
24 ms is optimal across devices, operating systems, event loops or model providers
Infinite Faces as a native authoritative Genesis primitive
Measure p50, p95 and p99 added wall-clock latency on Linux and Windows event loops.
Verify active-workset scaling from 1 through 8 does not create serial per-face delay.
Inject mutually exclusive proposals at 23.9 ms, 24.1 ms and 32.1 ms boundaries.
Verify late proposals remain provenance-visible and cannot retroactively mutate a committed effect.
Verify timing fields never become authority or arbitration weight.
Freeze a production value only after the independent latency/conflict holdout.
